context: A boss reviews publication and ops
purpose: Teach: 寄稿/半角/尺/収まる/見逃せ/絞る/手すり/低め

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Get that industry magazine piece going. Make it happen.
lines.style: Sharp, efficient clip to each phrase. No warmth — pure direction. Eyes steady on the target. Expectation of compliance, not request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。フォーム入力、半角指定、社内徹底します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure the form input follows half-width spec across the board.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Confirming each point as he processes it. Slight pause between clauses — showing he's taking mental notes. Reliable, not enthusiastic.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 広告映像、尺が短すぎないか、確認しろ。
lines.en: Check the ad video runtime. Make sure it's long enough.
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike. Slight emphasis on 'check' — not a suggestion. Tone of someone used to being obeyed. Minimal intonation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクト、予算内に収まる見込みです。
lines.en: Got it. We should be able to keep the project within budget.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Measured pace — he's considered this. Small lift at the end, like a gentle confirmation rather than a promise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今回のミス、見逃せない、再発防止策、出せ。
lines.en: This mistake can't happen again. I need a prevention plan. Submit it.
lines.style: Harder edge now — disappointment underneath. Each sentence a separate weight. Not raised voice, but lowered tolerance. Deliberate, unyielding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経費、もっと絞る方針、徹底します。
lines.en: Understood. We'll tighten expenses going forward. I'll make sure it sticks.
lines.style: Quick acceptance, then steadying himself. Shows he heard the gravity. Quieter second half — internalizing the directive, committing to it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 階段、手すりが、緩んでいたな、注意しろ。
lines.en: By the way — the stair railing's come loose. Watch yourself.
lines.style: Tone shift here — almost conversational, practical concern. Mention it in passing but mean it. Brief, genuine. The boss as a person noticing something real.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来期、目標、低めに設定し、確実に達成します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll set more realistic targets for next term and make sure we hit them.
lines.style: Quieter, more settled. He's taking this in. Shows he understands the underlying lesson — aim lower, deliver reliably. Respectful close.
